name: Domestic Violence And Abuse
overview: Scripture condemns violence and those who love it, showing that the Lord hates such wickedness (Psalms 11:5). The Christian life calls for husbands to love their wives without bitterness (Colossians 3:19) and fathers to avoid provoking their children to anger or discouragement (Colossians 3:21). Believers are urged to be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger (James 1:19), reflecting the fruit of the Spirit rather than the works of the flesh, which include sinful behaviors that disrupt godly relationships (Galatians 5:19). These verses collectively teach that domestic violence and abuse are contrary to the character and commands of God for family relationships.
